chapter: Chicago clubs, entertainers and tent shows
title: Alberta Hunter as a young star at the Dreamland
summary: He heard Alberta Hunter and Ollie Powers at the Dreamland, where she was a big, fine young entertainer.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Now you went to Dreamland in the Bill Bottom days. Who did you hear there? Did you hear Ollie Powers, Alberta Hunter?
Yes, Alberta Hunter, I heard her there. Ollie Powers was also -- yes.
Was Alberta, was she a big thing there?
She was a big thing then, at that time, yes. Alberta was a big star at the Dreamland.
Fairly young, yes. She was very nice, very fine entertainer. Singer, Alberta Hunter.
